integrity: Direct proof and exact symbolic checker; finite tests do not establish the all-parameter theorem.
scientific_limitations: Full classification only for nonzero rank-one operators on the complex Hilbert plane. The negative 2x2 witness answers the broader binary question, not a general higher-dimensional classification. Qualitative priority may overlap classical simultaneous projection metrics; no independent mathematical audit.
title: Sharp metric Moore–Penrose threshold for rank-one \(2\)-partial isometries
